name: Side-Lying Dumbbell External Rotation
description: Lying on your side with the top elbow bent at your side and a light dumbbell in front of your belly, rotate the forearm up toward the ceiling, keeping the elbow at your side, then lower.

source.title: ExRx: Dumbbell Lying Shoulder External Rotation
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on one side, head resting on the lower arm, knees bent.
Top elbow bent to a right angle and tucked at your side, a light dumbbell in that hand.
cues: Elbow stays glued to your side.
Turn only as far as is comfortable.

prescription.note: A light weight; a folded towel between elbow and side helps.

keyframes.name: Forearm across
keyframes.cue: Top elbow bent at your side, the weight in front of your belly.

keyframes.name: Rotate up
keyframes.cue: Turn the forearm up; the elbow stays at your side.
